name: 60639 · Chicago, IL
findings: ZIP 60639 (Chicago) has 150 nonprofit organizations. 59 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (46% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60639 (Chicago) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
